frs.title: Candidate Scoring & Ranking Engine (Unspecified Weighting)
frs.description: The system shall rank candidates based on relevance, skills, and overall profile strength (exact scoring weights pending clarification).
frs.originalText: Mainly skills and experience. And overall profile strength. Things like good companies, solid projects...

frs.sourceStatement: Mainly skills and experience. And overall profile strength.

frs.title: Explainability & Match Insights (Unspecified Presentation Schema)
frs.description: The system shall provide useful explainability for hiring decisions (presentation format and schema unclarified).
frs.originalText: Do we need explainability? / Yes, that would be useful.
frs.refinedText: Explainability presentation schema pending recruiter preference.
frs.sourceStatement: Do we need explainability? Yes, that would be useful.

frs.title: Role-Based Recruiter Access (Baseline)
frs.description: The system shall allow authorized hiring managers and HR recruiters to submit job descriptions and review candidate shortlists.
frs.originalText: We need to build an AI-based resume analyzer... We want it to take resumes and rank them based on relevance to a job description.
frs.refinedText: Authorized HR recruiters can create JDs and view ranked candidates.
acceptanceCriteria: Recruiter can log in and submit JD
frs.sourceStatement: We need to build an AI-based resume analyzer.

nfrs.title: Processing Latency & Response Time
nfrs.description: The system shouldn't be slow and response time per resume should ideally be quick.
nfrs.originalText: It shouldn't be slow. / Ideally quick.
nfrs.refinedText: System processing time should be quick (pending latency SLO).
nfrs.sourceStatement: It shouldn't be slow. Ideally quick.
ambiguityFlags: 'Not slow' and 'quick' are unmeasurable subjective predicates

nfrs.title: Fairness & Demographic Bias Mitigation
nfrs.description: The system must avoid bias, especially related to gender or college background.
nfrs.originalText: Yes, we must avoid bias, especially related to gender or college background.
nfrs.refinedText: Avoid demographic bias (pending Disparate Impact threshold).
nfrs.metric: Awaiting Disparate Impact Ratio / Parity Metric
acceptanceCriteria: System does not show obvious bias
nfrs.sourceStatement: Yes, we must avoid bias, especially related to gender or college background.
ambiguityFlags: 'Avoid bias' lacks concrete mathematical threshold (e.g. 0.80 - 1.25 DIR)

nfrs.title: Candidate Matching Quality & Accuracy

nfrs.title: Candidate PII Protection & Data Privacy
nfrs.description: Candidate personally identifiable information (PII) must be stored with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
nfrs.originalText: Candidate resumes contain personal contact information.
nfrs.refinedText: PII stored securely with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
nfrs.targetThreshold: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, GDPR Article 32 compliant
acceptanceCriteria: Given candidate resume upload, When stored in database, Then PII fields are encrypted with AES-256.
Given API communication, When data is in transit, Then TLS 1.3 is enforced.
nfrs.sourceStatement: Candidate resumes contain personal contact information.

nfrs.title: Recruiter Interface Usability Benchmark
nfrs.description: The recruiter dashboard interface shall achieve System Usability Scale (SUS) score >= 80.0.
nfrs.originalText: HR recruiters will use this dashboard daily.
nfrs.refinedText: Interface usability compliant with System Usability Scale (SUS) score >= 80.0.
acceptanceCriteria: Given first-time recruiter user, When evaluating candidate shortlist, Then task completion occurs in < 3 minutes without formal training.
Given usability evaluation with 10 HR users, When scored, Then average SUS score exceeds 80.0.
nfrs.sourceStatement: HR recruiters will use this dashboard daily.
